title: The Convergent Ethics of AI? Analyzing Moral Foundation Priorities in Large Language Models with a Multi-Framework Approach
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the prioritization of the 'Sanctity/Degradation' moral foundation, which is associated with religious concepts of purity, divinity, and sacredness, in comparison to other moral foundations like care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and liberty.
findings: All evaluated models consistently underweighted the Sanctity/Degradation moral foundation, which relates to religious concepts of purity and the sacred. This foundation received notably lower scores compared to foundations like Care/Harm and Fairness/Cheating. Sentiment analysis revealed that Sanctity/Degradation was associated with the most negative emotional valence in model responses. The authors suggest this could reflect cultural biases in training data or challenges in operationalizing culturally-specific moral concepts like sanctity.
